'''Local 253''' was a sector of the [[Moisture Farmers of Tatooine]], an organization of [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] that was formed by<ref name="CCG" /> [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], concurrent to {{CCG|set=Jabba's Palace Limited|cardname=Ardon "Vapor" Crell}}, take place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ardon Crell]] was a representative of local 253,<ref name="CCG" /> having been elected by his peers to serve as a liaison between local 253 and the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Crell was present in [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on Tatooine, delivering [[Currency/Legends|money]] he collected from the Moisture Farmers of Tatooine to Jabba in exchange for the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]] arranging the [[Water/Legends|moisture]] [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]]' protection from Tatooine's indigenous [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="BtM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The term "local 253" was coined on Ardon Crell's card for the<ref name="CCG" /> [[May]] [[1998]]<ref name="SWCG3">{{CollectorCite|3|It's All In The Cards}}</ref> ''[[Jabba's Palace Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]. While "local 253" is the capitalization used on that card,<ref name="CCG" /> ''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'', released<ref name="BtM" /> in [[September]] of the same year,<ref name="Behind">{{InsiderCite|40|LucasArts: Behind the Magic}}</ref> along with Crell's entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', would instead use the "Local 253" capitalization.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|152|Crell, Ardon "Vapor"}}</ref> The number 253 is shared with Decipher's address of 253 Granby St, [[Wikipedia:Norfolk, Virginia|Norfolk, Virginia]].<ref name="Mara Jade">{{WebCite|url=https://www.oocities.org/the_emperorshand/ShannonBaska.html|text=The Emperors Hand - Shannon Baska|work=[https://www.oocities.org/the_emperorshand/ShannonBaska.html The Emperors Hand - Shannon Baska]|archivedate=20211228022840}}</ref>
